intro: Checks that the spring controls the valve at the target speed (no float) and does not reach coil bind.
follower_hint: Rocker or bucket; 0 for direct acting

warn.increase_rate: Margin too small: stiffer spring or lighter parts (titanium valves or retainers).
warn.use_dual: Margin too small: switch to stiffer dual springs or lighten the valvetrain.
warn.bind: Coil bind clearance too small: the spring may break or lock the camshaft.
warn.rpm: The target speed exceeds the recommended maximum for this spring.
warn.method: Harmonic cam model: an aggressive cam (short ramps) needs 10 to 20% more force.

chart.force_title: Spring force and required force versus lift
